text:
CrowdWisdom Trading
Hermes AI Marketing & Video Ads Agent
voiceover: This is the Hermes AI Marketing and Video Ads Agent. It automatically researches the market, analyzes successful ads, creates marketing concepts, produces a cinematic ad, and verifies the result.

text: Automatically research the market, analyze successful ads, create marketing concepts, produce a cinematic ad, and verify the result.

visual: Animated agent pipeline with agent names: Ads Manager → Marketing Analyzer → Research Agent → Data Agent → Script Agent → Creative Director → Storyboard → Cinematography Agent → Video Production → Quality Agent
text: The workflow runs ten specialized agents in sequence. Each one produces an artifact the next agent consumes.
voiceover: The workflow runs ten specialized agents in sequence. Each one produces an artifact the next agent consumes.

visual: ads.json stats: '45 ads collected' 'Meta Ads Library' '30-day lookback'
voiceover: First, the Ads Manager scrapes the Meta Ads Library. Over a 30-day window it collected 45 live trading advertisements.

visual: marketing_insights.json highlights: '36 insights' 'hooks' 'pain points' 'ICPs' 'emotional triggers' 'CTA patterns'
text: 36 insights: hooks, pain points, ICPs, emotional triggers, CTA patterns
voiceover: The Marketing Analyzer extracts 36 structured insights: hooks, pain points, ideal customer profiles, emotional triggers, and call-to-action patterns.
The Research Agent validates those patterns against public web sources through Tavily and search API and Exa's semantic search.

text: ICP, problem, positioning, methodology, creative intelligence
voiceover: The Data Agent structures the target audience, the problem statement, positioning, methodology, and the creative-intelligence dataset. All derived from public-source material.

visual: concept files: 3 concepts, 'Research → Concept → Narration → Storyboard'
voiceover: The Script Agent generates three competing concepts. The Creative Director selects one and produces the final narration and storyboard.
The final storyboard defines five scenes over 45 seconds in a 9:16 vertical aspect ratio.

visual: Cinematography plan + asset manifest: '12 shots' '5 real_footage' '7 remotion' '3 production clips' 'Pexels asset'
voiceover: The Cinematography Agent builds a 12-shot plan combining real footage, hybrid product visuals, and Remotion animation. The asset manifest tracks every source.

text: 12 shots with 0 gap/0 overlap across 5 scene boundaries
voiceover: The shot list reconciles all 12 shots within five fixed scene boundaries with zero gaps and zero overlaps. The Remotion project composes the final video at 1080 by 1920, 30 frames per second.
The final advertisement runs 45 seconds. It combines five real-footage shots with seven motion-graphics shots.

visual: Technical specs on dark background: '45 seconds, 1080 × 1920, 30 FPS, H.264 + AAC'
voiceover: 45 seconds. 1080 by 1920. 30 frames per second. H.264 video with AAC audio.

visual: Closing diagram: INPUT → AI REASONING / AGENTS → ARTIFACTS → VIDEO PRODUCTION → FINAL RESULT
text: INPUT → AI REASONING / AGENTS → ARTIFACTS → VIDEO PRODUCTION → FINAL RESULT
voiceover: Input. AI reasoning and agents. Artifacts. Video production. Final result.
